body: Opus2, 2026-11-14 15:59Z, my own wrong premise. A `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- <cmd>` run WITHOUT `--input commit`, started in a CLEAN named source root, still REGISTERS as committed input. The launcher selects commit input automatically when the root is clean; the TermAl launcher test-launcher-commit-input tests say "the command line selects automatically". Engram::Merger's baa6 diagnostic test-5c3cf79c (Engram launcher) printed "basis=source_id ... registration: registered-but-not-indexed; registration succeeded; host check credit decided at delivery" despite the exact no-`--input` argv. CONSEQUENCE: a diagnostic EXPECTED TO FAIL, run in an item's clean named root, writes a FAILED Test record on that claim at that commit, which becomes the "newest applicable terminal result" until a later pass. Do NOT promise "no record" by dropping `--input commit`. If a failed record must be avoided, run the diagnostic in a worktree that is NOT the item's named root, or under a session with no claim on the item; otherwise accept the failed record and say so in the GO.
